ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the above food web diagram, which species provide energy to mice?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the middle of the food web diagram there is a vertical food chain, with the bottom labeled "wheat", the middle labeled "field mice", and the top labeled "hawk". The arrows point upward from "wheat" to "field mice", and then upward from "field mice" to "hawk". Reasoning: Arrows in a food web indicate that energy is transferred from the organism being eaten to the feeder. Because the source of the arrow pointing to "field mice" is "wheat", the species that provides energy for mice is wheat.
